描述_EN: ‘and, yeah…’ he said.”2 during the iphone 6’s launch period, there were several stories reported on in the media about iphone 6 bending when carried in a trouser pocket. (see references). ian parker, writing a profile piece for the new yorker in  february 2015, asked jonathan ive about the protruding camera; “ive referred to that decision  – without which the phone would be slightly thicker – as ‘a really very pragmatic optimization’. the revised design of the iphone 6 received considerable criticism as its extreme thinness meant that the rear-facing camera protrudes out from the device. the iphone 6 is available in three finishes gold, silver, and, as with our acquired examples, space grey. the iphone 6’s screen size across the diagonal is 119 mm (4.7 inches) and the iphone 6 plus’ screen is 140 mm (5.5 inches), as well as being the thinnest phone at 6.9 mm that apple has produced. software changes were also introduced  including a ‘reachability’ one-handed gesture; double-tapping the home button slides the top  half of the screen's contents down to the bottom bringing it within reach of the user’s thumb. the phone  has a glass front which for the first time curves around the edges of the display and an  aluminium back; this features two plastic strips, known as antenna bands, which allow radio  waves to get through the aluminium exterior. tom warren of the verge noted that in press images on its website apple removed the camera using photoshop, to keep the look of the phone ‘streamlined’1. from the iphone 6’s launch on 19 september 2014, apple sold around 34,000 phones per hour, every day for three months, with 74.5 million sold in this period alone. as with all previous iphones, the iphone 6 has a touchscreen and a rear-facing camera, and like all iphones post version 4, it also features a front-facing camera. apple responded that they had only received nine complaints about this in the 16 days following its launch, a period in which they sold 10 million phones.3 despite these criticisms, the iphone 6 is the product that made apple the most profitable company to have ever existed, with quarterly profits from october to december 2014 of $18bn. apple began manufacturing smartphones in 2007 and when launched the wall street journal, described the iphone as, “on balance, a beautiful and breakthrough handheld computer” .4 apple’s ability to make the web truly mobile has been the most influential factor in its continued success. one had to guess at the drama behind the phrase. to accommodate the larger physical size of the iphone 6 and 6s, the power button has moved from the top to the side to improve accessibility. released along with the iphone 6 plus on 9 september 2014, these models have the largest displays of any iphone to date. sales increased by 70% in china, the world’s biggest smartphone market, despite costing much more than products designed and manufactured by domestic companies such as xiaomi. the decision to increase the size of the iphone was a response to the rise of the phablet, devices between 127 and 152 mm (5 and 6 inches) that straddle the smartphone and tablet market and include successful product lines such as samsung’s galaxy note. these larger- sized smartphones had been taking market share from both apple’s smaller smartphones and their ipad tablet computers.
描述_ZN: '而且，是的......'他说。"2在iPhone 6上市期间，媒体报道了几个关于iPhone 6在裤袋中携带时弯曲的故事。 （见参考文献）。 ian parker, writing a profile piece for the new yorker in  february 2015, asked jonathan ive about the protruding camera; “ive referred to that decision  – without which the phone would be slightly thicker – as ‘a really very pragmatic optimization’. iPhone 6的修订设计受到了相当多的批评，因为它的极度轻薄意味着后置摄像头从设备上突出来。 iPhone 6有三种颜色，金色、银色和太空灰，就像我们获得的例子一样。 iphone6的屏幕对角线尺寸为119毫米（4.7英寸），iphone6 plus的屏幕尺寸为140毫米（5.5英寸），同时也是苹果公司生产的最薄的手机，厚度为6.9毫米。 software changes were also introduced  including a ‘reachability’ one-handed gesture; double-tapping the home button slides the top  half of the screen's contents down to the bottom bringing it within reach of the user’s thumb. the phone  has a glass front which for the first time curves around the edges of the display and an  aluminium back; this features two plastic strips, known as antenna bands, which allow radio  waves to get through the aluminium exterior. The verge的Tom Warren指出，在其网站上的新闻图片中，苹果用Photoshop去掉了摄像头，以保持手机的外观 "精简 "1。 从2014年9月19日iPhone 6发布开始，苹果每小时售出约34,000部手机，连续三个月每天都是如此，仅在这一时期就售出7450万部。 和以前所有的苹果手机一样，iPhone 6有一个触摸屏和一个面向后方的摄像头，和所有第四版以后的苹果手机一样，它也有一个面向前方的摄像头。 苹果公司回应说，他们在发布后的16天内只收到了9起投诉，这期间他们卖出了1000万部手机。3尽管有这些批评，iPhone 6是让苹果成为有史以来最赚钱的公司的产品，2014年10月至12月的季度利润为180亿美元。 苹果公司于2007年开始生产智能手机，在推出时，《华尔街日报》将iPhone描述为："总的来说，这是一款漂亮的、具有突破性的掌上电脑。"4苹果公司使网络真正移动的能力是其持续成功的最有影响力的因素。 人们不得不猜测这句话背后的戏剧性。 为了适应iphone6和6s更大的物理尺寸，电源按钮从顶部移到了侧面，以提高可及性。 在2014年9月9日与iPhone 6 plus一起发布，这些机型拥有迄今为止所有iPhone的最大显示屏。 在中国这个世界上最大的智能手机市场，销售量增加了70%，尽管成本比小米等国内公司设计和制造的产品高得多。 增加iPhone尺寸的决定是对平板电脑崛起的回应，平板电脑的尺寸在127至152毫米（5至6英寸）之间，横跨智能手机和平板电脑市场，包括成功的产品线，如三星的Galaxy Note。 这些大尺寸的智能手机已经从苹果的小型智能手机和他们的ipad平板电脑中抢占了市场份额。
